oneLiner: A group order where N people spend under one hard budget, trade unused sub-budget with each other, and a checkout agent mints a Rain scoped card for exactly the final total — rendered as a lantern-lit night market where the scoped card materializes as a spell card carrying its real rules.
pitchLine: Spell cards for agents: controls declared before any money moves.
deadline: Submissions close Sunday Aug 9 12:00. Demo video recorded around midnight Saturday.

contextForEveryIteration.whatThisIs: A Slack-or-web group food order. An admin sets a total budget, a merchant, and a timer. Each participant picks items via an agent. Anyone over their share can ask the group for budget; others with surplus give it up, partial fills allowed. When the timer expires, a checkout agent mints ONE Rain scoped card for exactly the final group total, discovers the merchant via its llms.txt, and pays. A scripted incident triggers a partial authorization reversal. Settlement fires per-person Monad transfers for each person's actual post-trade spend.
contextForEveryIteration.whyItWins: Rain's own thesis is controls declared in code before authorization. This animates that literally: the card does not exist until the group finishes deciding, is scoped to the final total, is bound to the merchant category, and dies on contact. Most teams will issue a card and buy one thing. Full lifecycle — issue, authorize, decline, settle, reverse, refund, reconcile — is what earns the hiring conversation.
contextForEveryIteration.theSeam: shared/events.mjs is the contract between backend and renderer. Backend emits, renderer theatricalizes. Never change an event's shape without updating that file first.

VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.note: All verified live against api-dev.raincards.xyz/v1 with Team 31 credentials on 2026-08-08. Do NOT re-derive these from marketing docs; the docs disagree with the API in two places.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.sessionId: NOT desk-issued. Generated client-side by RSA-OAEP encrypting a random 32-hex secret with Rain's published public key. src/rainsession.mjs does it. A fresh one per call is fine.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.scopedCardEnforcesMcc: TRUE. An off-allowlist merchant is declined with declinedReason 'scoped_card_mcc_not_allowed'. We pass no declineReason to get this — it is Rain's own decision. THIS IS THE GUARDRAIL BEAT.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.scopedCardDoesNotEnforceAmount: TRUE and important. A card requested at 7340 cents reads back limit {amount:8808, frequency:'allTime'} and still authorizes 8809. NEVER narrate the dollar figure as Rain-enforced.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.scopedCardIsSingleUse: Flips to status 'canceled' after ONE SUCCESSFUL authorization. A DECLINED authorization leaves it active. Therefore: run the decline beat FIRST, the real charge LAST.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.plainCardEnforcesAmount: POST /issuing/users/{uid}/cards with limit.frequency='perAuthorization' declines cents+1 with 'card_spending_limit_exceeded'. No sessionid needed. But allowedMccs and expiresAt are silently dropped on plain cards.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.settleNeedsAmount: POST /simulate/transactions/{id}/settle REQUIRES {amount} in the body. Empty body 400s.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.reverseAndRefund: POST /simulate/transactions/{id}/reverse and /refund both work, returning completionReason 'authorization_reversal' and 'refund'.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.balances: GET /issuing/balances returns {creditLimit, pendingCharges, postedCharges, balanceDue, spendingPower}. This is Rain-authoritative. Put it on screen when claiming money moved.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.transactionsAreNested: GET /issuing/transactions rows are {id, type:'spend', spend:{amount, merchantName (SPACE PADDED), merchantCategoryCode, cardId, status,...}}.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.sharedAccount: This is a SHARED team sandbox with other people's probe rows in it. Always filter by your own cardIds before displaying.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.deadEnds: GET /issuing/contracts -> 403. Payment-route transfers never reach a terminal state (observed stuck in 'processing' 890s+). Do not build on either.
VERIFIED_RAIN_FACTS.rationing: Documented per user per rolling 24h: 10 active scoped cards, 10 created, $5000 approved spend. Do exploratory work on PLAIN cards; save scoped issuance for real runs.

honestyRules: Never pass declineReason to force a decline and then present it as Rain enforcing a rule.
Never print a number on the projector that did not come off the wire, unless it is labelled as the group ledger's own arithmetic.
If a step cannot run live, it must say so in its own output rather than silently falling back to simulation.

theOneScenario.note: Build toward THIS EXACT RUN, not toward a general system. Every milestone is done when it moves this specific scenario forward. If a design decision does not change what happens in this script, it is out of scope. These are the literal values to hardcode as the default seeded order.
script: 1. Order opens. 3 spirits arrive at the market. Each lantern is full at $10.00.
2. Carson adds Moon Burger $8.99. His lantern dims to $1.01 remaining.
3. Alex adds Moon Burger $8.99 and Barley Tea $2.49 = $11.48. He is $1.48 OVER his $10.00 share.
4. Alex's agent asks the group for $1.48. Dana has spent nothing.
5. Dana gives $1.48. Coins arc from Dana's spirit to Alex's. Alex is now exactly at $11.48 of an $11.48 allowance.
6. Dana adds Fox Nuggets $5.49 from her remaining $8.52.
7. Carson locks. His unspent $1.01 releases to the pool.
8. Timer expires. Order closes. GROUP TOTAL = 899 + 1148 + 549 = 2596 cents ($25.96), under the $30.00 cap.
9. Checkout agent mints ONE Rain scoped card for 2596 cents scoped to MCC 5814. Spell card materializes printing the REAL last4 and $25.96 and MCC 5814.
10. GUARDRAIL BEAT: the agent tries the same $25.96 at MCC 5999. Rain declines: scoped_card_mcc_not_allowed. Spell card flashes and holds. Card is still active because declines do not consume it.
11. Real charge: $25.96 at MCC 5814. Authorized. Settled. Card flips to canceled.
12. Rain balances() on screen: spendingPower drops by exactly 2596.
13. INCIDENT: Fox Nuggets unavailable. Reverse $5.49. Spell card cracks, coins fly back to Dana. balances() shows spendingPower rise by exactly 549.
14. Settle-up: 3 Monad transfers for each person's actual post-trade spend (899, 1148, 0), danmaku streams with real confirmedMs.
15. Final frame: group ledger total and Rain's posted total agree to the cent.
theOneScenario.theOneSentence: The card did not exist until the group finished deciding, was scoped to exactly what they decided, only worked at that merchant, and died on contact.

milestones.goal: Preflight. Prove the Rain rail answers before writing product code.
milestones.detail: Write preflight.mjs that: reads .env.local, calls balances(), issues ONE plain card at 500 cents perAuthorization, authorizes 500 (expect authorized) and 501 (expect declined card_spending_limit_exceeded), and writes evidence/M0.json with {spendingPower, cardId, approvedTxId, declinedReason}. Use src/rain.mjs. Do not use scoped cards here — ration them.

milestones.goal: Order state machine + budget ledger + trading, pure and testable, no I/O.
milestones.detail: Pure module. createOrder({budgetTotal, participants, merchant, expiresAt}) -> state. Transitions: open -> locking -> closed. Operations: addItem, removeItem, lock (releases the locker's leftover to the pool), requestBudget, fillRequest (FCFS, PARTIAL FILLS ALLOWED — $1 from one person plus $1.40 from another), forceClose on timer. Invariant that must hold after EVERY operation and be asserted in tests: sum of all participant spend plus pool remaining === budgetTotal, and the group total NEVER exceeds budgetTotal. All money integer cents. Emits events via shared/events.mjs makeEvent. Include a test that a partial fill across two donors settles the shortfall exactly, and a test that an over-budget request that cannot be filled expires without breaking the invariant.

milestones.goal: Fake merchant with a menu and an llms.txt — the Rain Direct echo.
milestones.detail: A tiny in-process merchant: a fixed menu of ~10 items with integer-cent prices and MCC 5814, a getMenu(), and a checkout({items, cardLast4}) that returns an order id. public/llms.txt describes the storefront for agentic discovery in the style Rain's 'Rain Direct' R&D preview showed at the workshop: what the merchant sells, the endpoint to fetch the menu, and the checkout contract. This is a deliberate nod to their unreleased direction — keep it short and real, not decorative.

milestones.goal: Checkout agent: the finale, wired to the real Rain lifecycle.
milestones.detail: Given a closed order, run against the LIVE sandbox in this exact order because a scoped card is single-use: (1) issueScopedCard(total, ['5814']) and emit card_issued with the real last4; (2) THE GUARDRAIL BEAT — authorize the total at MCC 5999 against that card, expect status declined with declinedReason scoped_card_mcc_not_allowed, emit auth_declined (the card stays active through a decline); (3) authorize the total at MCC 5814, expect authorized, emit auth_approved; (4) settle(txId, total), emit auth_settled; (5) balances() and emit balances_updated. Write evidence/M3.json with the real cardId, last4, declinedReason, approved transactionId, and the spendingPower before and after.

milestones.goal: The scripted incident: partial authorization reversal and refund.
milestones.detail: After M3 settles, reverse a single participant's item amount and emit auth_reversed with that participant's id, then refund and emit refund_issued. Re-read balances() and emit balances_updated so the projector shows spendingPower moving back by exactly the reversed amount. Write evidence/M4.json with the reversed amount and the before/after pendingCharges proving the hold released to the cent.

milestones.goal: Event server: one websocket, one replayable log.
milestones.detail: Node http server, no framework, no new dependencies. Serves renderer/ statically. Holds the append-only event log for the current order. Upgrades to websocket and on connect replays the whole log from index 0, then streams live. Exposes POST /drive for the CLI driver to advance the order. Supports ?demo=1 which replays cannedStream() from shared/events.mjs so the renderer works with no backend state.

milestones.goal: The hanami renderer — the projector show.
milestones.detail: Single page, canvas, zero external dependencies (no CDN — venue wifi will betray you). Subscribes to the websocket and theatricalizes events. Required beats in priority order: participants as spirits arriving at lantern-lit stalls; a paper-lantern budget bar per person that dims as they spend; coins arcing between spirits on budget_traded; a moon or burning incense timer; and THE SPELL CARD — on card_issued an ornate card materializes printing the real last4, the amount, and MCC 5814. On auth_declined the card flashes and holds. On auth_reversed the card cracks and coins fly back. On settle_up_tx a danmaku bullet stream per transaction with its confirmedMs. Ignore unknown event types silently. IP: original art only, generic shrine-festival aesthetic, no named characters, no borrowed music.

milestones.goal: CLI driver so the whole show runs end to end without Slack.
milestones.detail: node drive.mjs --live runs a scripted order start-to-finish against the real Rain sandbox, driving M1 through M4 and emitting to the server. This is the demo spine and the thing that gets filmed. Slack is a later, cuttable layer; this must work first because a Slack app on venue wifi is the single most likely thing to fail on camera.

milestones.goal: Monad settle-up: each person pays their actual post-trade share.
milestones.detail: BLOCKED until MONAD_PRIVATE_KEY and a funded testnet wallet exist in .env.local. On auth_settled, send one transfer per participant for their exact post-trade spend to the admin address on Monad testnet, emitting settle_up_tx with the real txHash and measured confirmedMs. The justification for using a chain at all is that the split is provably fair to the cent. If blocked, write evidence/M8.json with {blocked: true, reason} and move on — do NOT fake a txHash.

Only start this once M7 films correctly. /order start <budget> <merchant> <minutes> @people, DM item selection, approve-trade buttons. If the venue network fights you, cut it and drive the demo from the CLI. Do not let this block the video.

cutOrderIfBehind: M8 Monad -> Rain-only story, mention chain in pitch
refund half of M4 -> keep the reversal only
LLM item selection -> fixed menu picks
NEVER CUT: scoped card with its real rules on the spell card, the MCC decline, auth->settle, one reversal, the trade animation
